items.reason: A gentle niacinamide serum suits oily-looking skin and works as a first active in the morning.
A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine simple and leaves the actives to do the work.
A lower-strength retinol is a sensible second active for a beginner who wants a smoother, more even-looking finish.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin feel, since the moisture score is moderate.
Daily mineral SPF is needed alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanser, niacinamide, moisturizer, then SPF; evenings: cleanser, retinol, then moisturizer, starting retinol just 2 nights a week and building up slowly. Stronger acids and peels were left out so the two actives stay easy to follow and comfortable.
